name: Preference list stacks beside the settings panel
looks: Three short lines stack in, each naming one personal setting with its key word in italic colour, while a real preferences panel slides in beside them, showing the matching controls (time zone, date format, keyboard shortcuts) stacked in sections.
build: list-stack-reveal for the three headline lines; the panel's sections stagger in on the same beat grid as the headline lines, each section landing just as its matching line does.
sound: A tick per line, synced with a lighter tick per settings section landing beside it.
prompt: Pair a short list of personal settings with a real settings panel: stack three lines naming individual preferences, each landing in sync with the matching section of a real preferences UI sliding in beside it, so the claim and the proof arrive together.
